_about.what: Proposed additions to obd_reader/data/dtc_generic.json. NOT loaded by anything — this is a review queue, not live data.
_about.why_it_exists: The catalog holds 18 codes covering three zones (engine, exhaust, ignition). Five zones — transmission, emissions, chassis, body, network — have no catalogued code at all, so their icons cannot render with a real description, and no scenario can exercise them properly. It also contains zero 'info' codes, which is why .fault-banner.info (style.css:24) has never rendered.
_about.descriptions_are_from_the_standard: Every description below is the generic SAE J2012 meaning. These are facts, not judgements.
_about.severities_are_NOT: Severity is an editorial judgement, per the DIAG-3 guardrail: only `description` may come from an outside source, `severity` stays a human call so the UI never marks something critical on the say-so of a scrape. The values below are Claude's proposals. Review each one before merging — particularly P0442.
_about.deliberately_omitted: P0128, P0455, P0740 and C0040 are left out on purpose so simulated_codes/uncatalogued.json keeps testing the degradation path after this is merged.
_about.how_to_use: Review, adjust severities, then fold the entries into dtc_generic.json's `codes` object as a separate commit. This is catalog data, not simulation, so it does not belong in the same change as the scenarios.

P0442.description: Evaporative emission system leak detected (small leak)

P0446.description: Evaporative emission system vent control circuit malfunction

C0035.description: Left front wheel speed sensor circuit malfunction

C0045.description: Left rear wheel speed sensor circuit malfunction

U0155.description: Lost communication with instrument panel cluster control module

_severity_notes_for_review.P0442: Proposed 'info' — a small EVAP leak is usually a loose fuel cap. It lights the check-engine lamp but nothing is failing. This is the only 'info' code in the whole catalog and the only thing that will exercise .fault-banner.info. If you disagree it should be info, the info severity has no producer again.
_severity_notes_for_review.B0001 / B0010: Proposed 'critical' — an airbag deployment circuit fault means the restraint may not fire in a crash. Nothing about the car drives badly, so it is a good test of severity being about consequence rather than driveability.
_severity_notes_for_review.U0100: Proposed 'critical' — losing the engine control module on the bus usually means the car is about to stop running.
_severity_notes_for_review.C0035 / C0045: Proposed 'warning' — a single wheel speed sensor disables ABS and stability control. Arguably critical. Your call.
